description: This file defines the 'Dish' result class for a database schema, including columns, relationships, and methods for recalculating ingredient quantities, deleting associated records, and preparing data for editing.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Dish
classes.description: A class representing a dish in the schema, with properties for its attributes and relationships, and methods for recalculating ingredient quantities, deleting, and preparing data for editing.

methods.name: recalculate
methods.description: Recalculates ingredient quantities based on new servings and updates related items.

methods.name: update_items_and_delete
methods.description: Removes ingredients from purchase list, deletes ingredients and the dish itself.

methods.name: for_meals_dishes_editor
methods.description: Prepares a hashref of dish data along with the associated meal's date for editing purposes.
